_comment: FROZEN momentum / reaction-entry selection constants. DO NOT EDIT (retune) after the first
edge-proof run. This is the audit-parity twin of baseline.frozen.json: it externalizes the
momentum harness's inline model constants so they are a declared, change-controlled artifact
rather than magic numbers buried in code (anti-p-hacking, red-team flaw 2A).
These VALUES ARE IDENTICAL to the constants previously inlined in aats/backtest/momentum_harness.py
(this file is an EXTERNALIZATION, not a retune). The canonical hash in `frozen_hash` is recomputed
deterministically from `params` alone; a test (tests/backtest) FAILS if any hashed value drifts.
THE MODEL RULE (momentum_harness.py, decide_momentum_entry): select iff, using ONLY the <=T_ENTRY
trajectory, (1) tradeable at T_ENTRY (non-null positive price), (2) early buy pressure
buys/(buys+sells) >= `buy_fraction_floor`, (3) price ROSE from the earliest pre-entry mark to the
T_ENTRY mark, (4) liquidity_usd > `min_liquidity_usd`. THE BASELINE (naive momentum, the GATE-B
control) is the strict SUBSET-parent: tradeable AND price rose ONLY (no buy-pressure / liquidity
filter). The baseline carries NO free numeric knob of its own; `buy_fraction_floor` and
`min_liquidity_usd` are the ONLY tunables and they gate the MODEL, never the baseline.
MONEY / THRESHOLD DISCIPLINE (data-models.md §0): every numeric is a Decimal-as-STRING, never a
float. `min_liquidity_usd` = "0" means a strictly-positive existence check (a real, sellable
market must exist) — it is a structural floor, not a fitted level.
FROZEN — MUST NOT BE TUNED AGAINST THE CORPUS. Changing a value here is p-hacking the selection
against the scoreboard; it is a TEST FAILURE, not an edit. Open an ADR + delta notice instead.

params_provenance.buy_fraction_floor: Frozen early buy-pressure floor: select only when buys/(buys+sells) at T_ENTRY >= this fraction. 0.55 = strictly more buyers than sellers by a clear margin (a curve where sells already match buys is NOT momentum). Illustrative placeholder, NOT a fitted parameter. Decimal-as-string, never float.
params_provenance.min_liquidity_usd: Frozen liquidity floor (USD): the model selects only when liquidity_usd is strictly greater than this value at T_ENTRY (a real, sellable market exists). 0 = strictly-positive existence check. Decimal-as-string, never float.

baseline_rule: naive momentum — enter every launch that is tradeable at T_ENTRY AND whose price ROSE to T_ENTRY ('buy what is going up'). No free numeric parameter; it is the strict superset of the model's selection.
